items.heading: Asado Uruguayo
details: Key ingredients: beef ribs, sausage, salt, chimichurri
Season various cuts of beef and sausage simply with salt.
Grill slowly over wood embers at a moderate distance.
Turn occasionally until deeply browned and tender throughout.
Serve sliced with chimichurri sauce on the side.

items.heading: Chivito
details: Key ingredients: steak, ham, cheese, egg, bacon, bun
Grill a thin steak until cooked to preference.
Layer the steak with ham, cheese, bacon and a fried egg.
Assemble everything on a soft bun with lettuce and tomato.
Serve with a side of fries.
